title: Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV (ro.product.model "SPPL 4K GSmartTV FF", product SW6H_Thomson, device SW6H,
header:
Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV (ro.product.model "SPPL 4K GSmartTV FF", product SW6H_Thomson, device SW6H,
Skyworth-built, MediaTek, 32-bit ARM), Android TV 14 (API 34), build UTT1.250517.001, ~1.9 GB RAM.
Same board and build as skyworth-sw-22sa. 4K panel drawn at 1920x1080 (wm size override from the factory).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/thomson-sppl-4k-sw6h/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/thomson-sppl-4k-sw6h/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock Home: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx; setupwraith's RecoveryActivity also claims HOME, and the
first build-and-install.sh run rolled back because RecoveryActivity took Home. The saved Wi-Fi network
belonged to setupwraith: forgotten + re-joined in Settings (then cname=android.uid.system), setupwraith
disabled, build-and-install.sh run again: mFocusedApp = com.gathin.tvhome/.MainActivity.
Live TV app: com.smartdevice.livetv; launcher Inputs menu lists HDMI 1-3, AV, Live TV and switches through it.
Remote: Input, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, mic all work without launcherx. The Settings/dashboard
button sends keycode 83 (KEYCODE_NOTIFICATION, scancode 240 KEY_UNKNOWN, HID 0c009f), which only launcherx
answered: settings_key_keycodes [83] in config.json here + HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1, checked with the real remote.
launcher/ config: config.json here (live_tv_package com.smartdevice.livetv, its tile hidden, Settings key).
Sideloading and a third-party HOME app install fine (pm install -r).

Applied on 2026-10-21 in batches with a screenshot after each; Live TV, HDMI, YouTube and Hotstar checked.
After a reboot `pm list packages -d` matched exactly: this firmware re-enables nothing at boot.

Disabled from the factory, so not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON): com.netflix.ninja.

Off on this unit by the owner's choice but left out of the list, since keyboards stay enabled:
org.liskovsoft.androidtv.rukeyboard (a Russian soft keyboard, not the active IME; Gboard is).

Kept on purpose: com.smartdevice.livetv + overlay_SANLUX, com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.tv.service,
com.mediatek.android.tv.globalkeyoverlay (Live TV, HDMI, hot keys), com.smartdevice.dailyshortcut (quick
menu), com.smartdevice.duplebluetooth + bleconnectservice (BLE remote pairing), com.smartdevice.factory and
mediatek.factorymenu.ui (never launched), com.tianci.localmedia, Play Store + Play Services, keyboard,
katniss + tv.assistant + tv.remote.service (voice, by choice), mediashell (Chromecast, by choice),
com.smartdevice.dtv.icast + com.mediatek.androidbox (Miracast/DLNA, by choice), Prime Video and YouTube
Music (by choice).
